## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the semantic owner of the change.

## Design alignment

- [ ] Existing specification/ADR is cited, or design changes were completed first.
- [ ] Schemas, diagnostics, migration notes, and examples are updated where applicable.
- [ ] No new compatibility promise is implied accidentally.

## Verification

- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `python conformance/run_conformance.py`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Wheel smoke test when runtime code or resources changed

## Licensing

- [ ] This change does not add third-party material without compatible, documented terms.
